checkpointRows.reviewNotes: The Subhuti citation scope is useful, but compiler, documentary narrator, and quoted-scripture ownership are all placed in MasterName. These roles must move to ActorAttribution/ContextMasters and exact utterers must be named.

The paired maneuvers are well distinguished from 把住 alone, but 'case commentator on Jiashan Shanhui' is a syntax label, not a roster master. Identify the commentator or use the reviewed non-master/narrated branch.

The exclamation/sky distinction is good, but compiler and documentary narrator labels occupy MasterName and Shakyamuni may be a quoted case figure. Speech punctuation alone does not establish the current container owner as utterer.

The birthday/calendar boundary is strong, but two documentary narrator labels and 'Zhenzong monk' are invalid MasterName values. Date headings and ceremony narration require exact non-master/narrated treatment.

The relational slot and anti-self warning are good, but a documentary narrator is stored as MasterName and quoted classification material may have later raisers. Verify exact utterers across the Caodong/Linji commentary chain.

The full-day time span is correctly pictured, but compiler and two documentary narrator labels occupy MasterName. Catalogue/narrative rows cannot be linked as masters, and Baozhi quotations need quoter versus original speaker separation.

The ordination-year seniority distinction is strong, but a documentary narrator is MasterName and several biographical counts are narration about a master, not speech by him. Person-described belongs in ContextMasters.

The formal greeting is concrete, but compiler, ceremony narrator, monastic-rule compiler, and lineage narrator labels are all MasterName. Most selected rows are actions/narration, so the current attribution model is inverted.

The named Linji category is cautiously handled, but compiler and lineage-sermon labels occupy MasterName and later quotations need quoter/original separation. The absence of three invented definitions is good but does not cure attribution.

The three referents are correctly split and distinguishable, but 'lineage narrator of Dayang disciples' and 'Fuxing monastery speaker' are role strings in MasterName. Proper-name catalogue and monastery-heading uses need narration/identified actors, not master links.
